Product Features

  • Wide-area compatibility: The total size is 180 x 35 x 45 cm. The elongated tabletop design provides a stable hold for TVs up to 80 inches, ensuring an immersive audiovisual experience and hassle-free handling of modern living room entertainment scenarios.
  • Extra large storage space: Equipped with 3 cabinet doors + a semi-open storage area, the overall structure is divided into 3 levels and offers plenty of storage space for easy storage of audiovisual equipment, game consoles and other miscellaneous items, keeping the living room tidy.
  • Safety glass partition: The semi-open area has an adjustable safety glass partition that is sturdy, durable, transparent and aesthetically pleasing. The room can be flexibly adjusted to the height of the objects and is suitable for both presentation and storage.
  • Large, level storage area: The generous storage area offers space for decorative items such as picture frames, vases and table lamps. The table is not only practical, but also a visual eye-catcher that underlines the style of the living room.
  • Smart Ambient Light Strip: Combined with an LED light strip controlled by a mobile app, you can change the light color and brightness as you like, making it easy to create a warm, cool, or romantic living room atmosphere and improve the quality of your home in no time.
  • High-gloss design: The front impresses with its high-gloss surface and the minimalist, black appearance looks stylish and elegant. Not only does it feel high-quality, but it's also easy to clean. A simple wipe is all it takes to keep them looking like new.
  • Robust and load-bearing material: The construction made of high-quality chipboard is stable and durable. The recommended load capacity is 30 kg, so TVs and other heavy objects can be safely placed on it. Even after many years of use, the piece of furniture hardly deforms.
  • Thoughtful and scientifically thought-out layout: 3-storey structure + 3 cabinet doors + semi-open area, clearly categorized storage space, closed area for hiding sundries, open area for displaying beautiful items, creating a neat and tidy living space.
  • Versatile and practical, the minimalist, high-gloss design in black matches a variety of interior styles, including modern, minimalist-luxurious, and gaming. Not only is it the perfect companion for your TV, but it's also a versatile storage unit and decorative element for your living room.
  • Note: This product is shipped in 2 packages and can be delivered in multiple partial deliveries. Please make sure you have received all the packages before you start building!

Descriptions

Descriptions

This TV cabinet measures 180 x 35 x 45 cm and has three doors that make the most of the storage space. In addition, it offers a semi-open compartment with adjustable shelves made of safety glass. The three-tier construction with a large shelf area at the top is suitable for TVs up to approx. 80 inches. The recommended load capacity is 30 kg. The cabinet features a high-gloss finish (front only) and LED light strips that can be controlled via app. It is made of chipboard.

App application and manager:

1. iOS and Android systems can download the "LotusLantern" app by scanning the QR code. To do this, open a browser or other tool with the "Scan QR Code" feature and scan the "LotusLantern" QR code (the QR code is in the user manual). 2. Click on the LotusLantern app icon to open the app page. 3. If Bluetooth is not enabled in the app interface, you will see the message "An application wants to enable the Bluetooth function of this device". Click 'Allow.' 4. Simply stick the light strip to a clean, dry surface with the self-adhesive backing. Use the included tape to improve adhesion. Please test the LED light strips before installation and install them carefully. If you have any questions, please contact us.
